player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Connect Four.
Your disc symbol: {symbol}.
The game board has {num_rows} rows and {num_cols} columns.
Players take turns dropping their disc into one of the columns (0 to {end_col}).
The first to connect (their own) four discs vertically, horizontally, or diagonally wins.
On your turn, enter the column number in squared brackets to make your move.
For example: '[col 4]' or '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Oyuncu {player_id}, Geçersiz hareket formatı. Beklenen format: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Oyuncu {player_id}, Geçersiz hareket. Sütun {col} sınırlar dışında.
